results.title: AFP Advances CHR Leadership with First Civilian Director I
results.intro_html: CAMP AGUINALDO, Quezon City -- The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) formally welcomed Ms. Marites M. Sierra as the first Director I of the AFP Civilian Human Resources (CHR) during an oath-taking ceremony held here. The ceremony was presided over by Lieutenant General Edmundo G. Peralta PA, The Deputy Chief of Staff, AFP representing AFP Chief of Staff General Antonio G. Nafarrete PA.
results.image_caption: Ms. Marites M. Sierra takes her oath as the first Director I of the AFP Civilian Human Resources before Lieutenant General Edmundo G. Peralta PA, The Deputy Chief of Staff, AFP, during the oath-taking ceremony on September 15 at Camp Aguinaldo.

results.title: AFP Strengthens Security Oversight for 2026 BARMM Parliamentary Elections
results.intro_html: CAMP AGUINALDO, Quezon City -- Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) Chief of Staff General Antonio G. Nafarrete, together with senior AFP officers, conducted continuous monitoring of the 2026 Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) Parliamentary Elections at Camp Siongco in Barangay Awang, Datu Odin Sinsuat, Maguindanao del Norte, on September 15.
results.image_caption: ⁨AFP Chief of Staff General Antonio G. Nafarrete emphasizes the AFP’s commitment to supporting a peaceful, secure, and credible 2026 Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) Parliamentary Elections during a media engagement at Camp Siongco in Barangay Awang, Datu Odin Sinsuat, Maguindanao del Norte, on September 15.⁩⁩

results.title: AFP Salutes GHQ and HSC Commander’s Service, Welcomes New Leadership
results.intro_html: CAMP AGUINALDO, Quezon City -- The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) honored Brigadier General Ricky A. Laniog PA for his decades of dedicated and exemplary service to the nation during a joint Retirement and Change of Command Ceremony of the General Headquarters and Headquarters Service Command (GHQ&HSC), on September 14, here.
results.image_caption: AFP Vice Chief of Staff Lieutenant General Rommel P. Roldan awards the Distinguished Service Medal to Brigadier General Ricky A. Laniog PA, outgoing Commander of the General Headquarters and Headquarters Service Command (GHQ&HSC) during the joint Retirement and Change of Command Ceremony, on September 14 at Camp Aguinaldo.

results.title: AFP Chief checks election security efforts in Central Mindanao
results.intro_html: CAMP AGUINALDO, Quezon City -- General Antonio G. Nafarrete PA, Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) visited two Army brigades in Central Mindanao on September 13 to check their election security preparations for the first Bangsamoro Parliamentary Election (BPE) 2026.
results.image_caption: General Antonio G. Nafarrete PA, Chief of Staff, AFP addresses troops of the 1st Mechanized Infantry “Maaasahan” Brigade, Armor Division, Philippine Army, during his visit in Tacurong City, Sultan Kudarat on September 13, 2026. (Photo by: PFC Carmelotes PN(M)/PAOAFP)

results.title: AFP Sustains Vigilance for Peaceful BARMM Parliamentary Elections
results.intro_html: CAMP AGUINALDO, Quezon City -- Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) Chief of Staff General Antonio G. Nafarrete, together with senior AFP officers, conducted continuous election monitoring on September 14, as the 2026 Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) Parliamentary Elections take place. The monitoring was conducted at Camp Siongco in Barangay Awang, Datu Odin Sinsuat, Maguindanao del Norte, as the AFP reinforced its commitment to supporting a peaceful, secure, and orderly electoral process.
results.image_caption: AFP Chief of Staff General Antonio G. Nafarrete discusses the latest security updates and operational measures during the 2026 BARMM Parliamentary Elections at Camp Siongco, Maguindanao del Norte, on September 14, 2026.

results.title: AFP Honors Exemplary Service at 2026 Metrobank Foundation Awards
results.intro_html: CAMP AGUINALDO, Quezon City  -- The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP), in partnership with the Metrobank Foundation and the Rotary Club of Makati, honored three exemplary military personnel during the 2026 Metrobank Foundation Outstanding Filipino Award for Soldiers (MFOFAS) ceremony held here today. The event was led by AFP Vice Chief of Staff Lieutenant General Rommel P. Roldan, representing AFP Chief of Staff General Antonio G. Nafarrete, who recognized the awardees for their outstanding contributions, dedication, and commitment to public service.
results.image_caption: AFP Vice Chief of Staff Lieutenant General Rommel P. Roldan, Major General Ramon P. Flores, AFP Deputy Chief of Staff for Personnel, J1, The AFP Sergeant Major, First Chief Master Sergeant (FCMS) Feliciano M Lazo, Mr. Philip Francisco U. Dy, President of the Metrobank Foundation, Inc., and Mr. Joseph Anthony M. Quesada, President of the Metrobank Foundation, Inc., gather with the 2026 MFOFAS awardees during the awarding ceremony on September 14, 2026, at Camp Aguinaldo.

results.title: AFP, US Pacific Command, Canadian Armed Forces successfully conduct 20th MMCA in Sulu Sea
results.intro_html: CAMP AGUINALDO, Quezon City  -- The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP), United States Pacific Command (USPACOM), and Canadian Armed Forces (CAF) successfully conducted the 20th Multilateral Maritime Cooperative Activity (MMCA) from September 12 to 13, 2026, in the Sulu Sea.
results.image_caption: BRP Suluan (MRRV-4406) and HMCS Regina (FFH 334) display coordination at sea with BRP Diego Silang (FFG7) during the Division Tactics/Officer of the Watch Maneuver Exercise for the 20th MMCA on 13 September 2026, in the Sulu Sea.

results.title: AFP Culminates 47th National Reservist Week, Underscores Reservists’ Critical Role in National Defense
results.intro_html: CAMP AGUINALDO, Quezon City -- The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) culminated the 47th National Reservist Week on September 12, highlighting the critical role of reservists in strengthening national defense and supporting the Regular Force.
results.image_caption: Defense Secretary Gilberto C. Teodoro Jr. together with active AFP members and reservists as well as stakeholders come together in a show of unity during the culmination ceremony of the 47th National Reservist Week on September 12 in Camp Aguinaldo, Quezon City. (Photo by SSg Ambay PA/PAOAFP)

results.title: AFP Chief Checks Troop Readiness in BARMM visit
results.intro_html: CAMP AGUINALDO, Quezon City -- Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) Chief of Staff General Antonio G. Nafarrete visited key military units in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region of Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) on September 11 to assess their preparations for the 2026 Bangsamoro Parliamentary Election (BPE).
results.image_caption: General Antonio G Nafarrete PA, AFP Chief of Staff delivers his guidance to the members of the 101st Infantry Brigade, Philippine Army during his visit to Lanao del Sur on September 11, 2026. (Photo by PFC Carmelotes PN(M)/PAOAFP)

results.title: AFP Honors Retiring First-Ever Intelligence Command Chief, Welcomes New Commander
results.intro_html: CAMP AGUINALDO, Quezon City -- The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) honored Lieutenant General Ferdinand T. Barandon PA as he retired after nearly four decades of service and turned over leadership of the Intelligence Command, AFP during a ceremony in Camp Aguinaldo on September 10, 2026.
results.image_caption: General Antonio G. Nafarrete PA, AFP Chief of Staff assisted by Mrs. Barandon, awards the Philippine Legion of Honor medal on Lieutenant General Ferdinand T. Barandon PA, during the Change of Command and Retirement Ceremony at Tejeros Hall, Camp Aguinaldo, Quezon City on September 10, 2026. (Photo by PFC Carmelotes PN(M)/PAOAFP)

results.title: AFP Chief Urges Airmen to Match Modern Capabilities with Professional Excellence
results.intro_html: CAMP AGUINALDO, Quezon City -- General Antonio G. Nafarrete, Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP), underscored the importance of professional competence, technical proficiency, and operational readiness during his Talk to Troops at Headquarters Philippine Air Force at Colonel Jesus Villamor Air Base, Pasay City on September 7.

results.title: AFP Joins Nation in Advancing Maritime Consciousness During MANA Mo 2026
results.intro_html: CAMP AGUINALDO, Quezon City -- The Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) joins the nation in observing the Maritime and Archipelagic Nation Awareness Month (MANA Mo) 2026 this September, under the theme “Karapatan sa Karagatan, Sama-sama Nating Alagaan.” The month-long observance underscores the Philippines’ identity and history as a maritime and archipelagic nation while promoting greater awareness of the country’s maritime interests, rights, and responsibilities.
results.image_caption: The Philippine flag is raised in recognition of the Maritime and Archipelagic Nation Awareness Month (MANA Mo) 2026, reaffirming the country’s identity as a maritime and archipelagic nation, on September 7 at Camp Aguinaldo.
